business_problem: Facing the challenge of increasing client demand and limited clinician resources, Medigold Health wanted to find ways to reduce administrative burdens on clinicians so they can focus more on patient care—and have better work-life balance.
solution_summary: Medigold Health improves lives of clinicians and clients with Azure Facing the challenge of increasing client demand and limited clinician resources, Medigold Health wanted to find ways to reduce administrative burdens on clinicians so they can focus more on patient care—and have better work-life balance. With Microsoft Azure as a foundation, the Medigold team migrated their applications to Azure App Service, and used Azure OpenAI Service for automated report generation, utilizing Azure Cosmos DB for logging and Azure SQL Database for data storage. Automated processes, especially with report generation, are saving clinicians time, leading to a 58% rise in clinician retention and greater job satisfaction. The implementation centers on Azure AI Services.
business_outcome: Medigold Health, one of the United Kingdom’s leading occupational health service providers, is dedicated to helping businesses keep employees healthy. The family-founded business specializes in providing organizations with advice and support to reduce workplace health risks and promote enhanced physical and mental wellbeing.
metrics: Automated processes, especially with report generation, are saving clinicians time, leading to a 58% rise in clinician retention and greater job satisfaction.

“We aim to improve service quality for clients and, with that, the work-life balance of our clinicians,” says Alex Goldsmith, Chief Executive Officer at Medigold Health, whose father, Dr. Mike Goldsmith, launched the company in 1998 with just five staff members. Now with over 1,000 employees and 450 clinicians and technicians, Medigold currently serves more than 3,500 businesses representing coverage of around 4.5 million employees.
